## At BWXT, we deliver innovative nuclear solutions to create a better world.

## [LEARN MORE >][132]

[BWXT US submarine on top of water]

## Naval Nuclear Propulsion

[BWXT submarine icon white on clear background]
350 +

Naval Nuclear Reactors

We have proudly manufactured naval nuclear components and reactors since the 1950s – we designed and
fabricated components for the USS Nautilus, the world’s first nuclear-powered submarine.

## [LEARN MORE >][133]

[BWXT steam generator cutout on a clear background]

## Commercial Nuclear Power Equipment

[BWXT steam generator icon white on a clear background]
200 +

Nuclear Steam Generators

We are capitalizing on the capabilities of our unique manufacturing facilities to meet the world’s
growing energy demands through nuclear power. 

## [LEARN MORE >][134]

[BWXT Technical Services Group TIG welding employees safety glasses on a clear background]

## Complex Site Operations

[BWXT nuclear technical services icon white on a clear background]
10

High Consequence Sites

Managed for the U.S. Government

We are making significant contributions to a cleaner future environment through our involvement with
the U.S. Department of Energy Environmental Management projects.

**Cooling Tower Depot^{®}** is a leading cooling tower manufacturing company, offering **[new       
cooling towers][22]**, **[major rebuilding and overhaul][23]** and **[inspection][24]** services,   
**[emergency response services][25]**, and the industry's only online store for **[DEPOT™ cooling   
towers][26]**. We manufacture and install field erected industrial cooling towers around the world, 
and ask to be included in the bidding process for your upcoming cooling tower projects.             
                                                                                                    
**DEPOT™** cooling tower models include large **[industrial cooling towers][27]** from 3,000 to     
300,000 gpm in both **[counterflow][28]** and **[crossflow][29]** configurations, double wall CFU   
cooling towers as well as **[packaged cooling towers][30]** with low flow rates.                    
                                                                                                    
**Welcome to the only [online warehouse][31] for cooling-tower parts.**                             
Cooling Tower Depot® makes it quick and easy to find the parts you need for your cooling tower.     
Simply choose a parts category and we'll provide you with product listings, pricing and purchasing  
options--all online.                                                                                
                                                                                                    
If at any time you would like to speak with one of our knowledgeable service representatives, or if 
you require an official bid, please call us at 1-877-243-3945. Our goal is to provide you with the  
information necessary to ensure you get the right parts every time you order.

# A History of Innovation and… the pursuit of Perfect Air

Lennox (NYSE:LII) is a leading worldwide provider of climate control solutions for air conditioning,
heating, and refrigeration. We have built our business on a heritage of integrity and innovation
dating back to 1895.

## The Ultimate System for Perfect Air

The Ultimate Comfort System™ combines the best of the Dave Lennox Signature® Collection to create an
unprecedented whole-home comfort system that seamlessly and intelligently works together to stay
finely tuned to your home and deliver consistently clean, perfect air.

[Learn More][19]
2/8 [Icon Pagination]

## Indoor Air Quality

Perfect air is about more than just how it feels, but what it contains. Lennox offers a range of
advanced air purification, filtration, humidity control and ventilation systems to help ensure the
air inside your home is as clean, healthy and comfortable as you'd like it to be.

[Start Saving][21]

## Lennox® Smart Thermostats

Lennox offers a suite of technologically advanced controls and zoning products designed to help you
customize the air in your home and tune your system to your personal degree of perfection.

[Explore Smart Thermostats][23]
4/8 [Icon Pagination]

[Explore Smart Thermostats][24]

## Variable Refrigerant Flow

Unlock the potential of your commercial spaces with Lennox VRF – tailored to meet the diverse needs
of various structures and industries. Low sound levels make for effective classroom learning
environments, and better temperature control lets every office, common area or apartment stay
comfortable.

[Explore the full Line][25]

[Cloud Top] [ Variable Refrigerant Flow Product ] [Cloud Bottom]

Elevate your business environment with Lennox HVAC solutions, addressing one of the top five
environmental risks identified by the U.S. EPA – poor indoor air quality (IAQ). With options that
regulate humidity levels and effectively eliminate contaminants, Lennox HVAC solutions create a
healthier workspace for your team and customers.

[Learn more][27]
6/8 [Icon Pagination]
[Cloud Top] [ Air Quality Product ] [Cloud Bottom]

Elevate your commercial climate control with ComfortSense thermostats, offering a seamless and
efficient temperature management experience. Designed with advanced features, heightened application
flexibility, and energy efficiency, these commercial thermostats are tailor-made to optimize the
performance of your Lennox rooftop equipment.

[Learn More][29]

consider energy bills, maintenance, and unit lifetime.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Common questions about chillers, cold rooms and refrigeration systems

What is an Industrial Cooling System?

An industrial cooling system is designed to remove excess heat generated by machines, manufacturing
processes, and industrial equipment. It helps maintain stable operating temperatures, improves
production efficiency, and protects valuable machinery from overheating. As one of the trusted
industrial cooling system manufacturers, we provide advanced industrial cooling solutions and
industrial water cooling systems that deliver reliable performance across a wide range of
industries.

How do you choose an Industrial Chiller?

Selecting the right industrial chiller depends on factors such as cooling capacity, process
temperature, heat load, ambient conditions, and the type of application. You should also consider
energy efficiency, installation space, and future expansion requirements. Leading industrial water
chiller manufacturers help evaluate these factors and recommend the ideal industrial air chiller or
water-based cooling solution for maximum performance and long-term savings.

What is an Air Cooled Chiller?

An air cooled water chiller is a cooling system that removes heat from industrial processes using
ambient air instead of water. It uses condenser fans to dissipate heat, making installation simple
and maintenance cost-effective. As experienced air cooled chiller manufacturers, we design highly
efficient air cooled chillers suitable for manufacturing units, pharmaceutical plants, food
processing facilities, plastic industries, and commercial buildings.

What is the difference between Air Cooled and Water Cooled Chillers?

The primary difference lies in the method of heat rejection. Air cooled chillers use surrounding air
to cool the condenser, making them easier to install and ideal for locations with limited water
availability. Water-cooled chillers use cooling towers and water circulation, offering higher
efficiency for large-scale operations. Choosing the right system depends on your cooling
requirements, operating environment, energy goals, and available infrastructure.

Which industries require Industrial Cooling?

Industrial cooling is essential wherever machinery or production processes generate excessive heat.
Industries such as pharmaceuticals, plastics, chemicals, food and beverage, dairy, printing,
textiles, packaging, metal processing, automotive, and HVAC manufacturing depend on efficient
industrial cooling solutions to maintain product quality, improve equipment life, and ensure
uninterrupted operations.

What capacity chillers do you manufacture?

We manufacture industrial chillers in a wide range of cooling capacities to meet the requirements of
both small-scale and large industrial applications. Whether you need a compact industrial air
chiller or a high-capacity cooling system for continuous production, our engineering team delivers
reliable and energy-efficient solutions tailored to your operational needs.

Do you provide customized cooling solutions?

Yes. We specialize in designing customized industrial cooling solutions based on your industry,
production process, cooling load, temperature requirements, and available installation space. Our
experienced engineers develop tailor-made systems that maximize efficiency, reduce operating costs,
and deliver dependable long-term performance for diverse industrial applications.

Do you export worldwide?

Yes. We supply high-quality industrial cooling equipment to customers across international markets.
As a trusted air cooled chiller supplier and one of the reliable industrial water chiller
manufacturers, we ensure every system meets international quality standards while providing complete
technical support, documentation, and timely delivery for global clients.

What is a Chiller Plant?

A chiller plant is a centralized cooling system that produces chilled water and distributes it
throughout an industrial or commercial facility for process cooling or air conditioning. It consists
of chillers, pumps, piping, controls, and heat exchangers working together to provide efficient and
consistent cooling. Properly designed chiller plants significantly reduce energy consumption and
improve operational reliability.

How does a Cold Room Work?

A cold room maintains a controlled low-temperature environment using refrigeration equipment that
continuously removes heat from the enclosed space. High-quality insulation minimizes heat transfer,
while precise temperature controls ensure products remain fresh and protected. Cold rooms are widely
used for storing food products, pharmaceuticals, chemicals, dairy items, and other

## Frequently Asked Questions

Common questions about chillers, cold rooms and refrigeration systems

What is an Industrial Cooling System?

An industrial cooling system is designed to remove excess heat generated by machines, manufacturing
processes, and industrial equipment. It helps maintain stable operating temperatures, improves
production efficiency, and protects valuable machinery from overheating. As one of the trusted
industrial cooling system manufacturers, we provide advanced industrial cooling solutions and
industrial water cooling systems that deliver reliable performance across a wide range of
industries.

How do you choose an Industrial Chiller?

Selecting the right industrial chiller depends on factors such as cooling capacity, process
temperature, heat load, ambient conditions, and the type of application. You should also consider
energy efficiency, installation space, and future expansion requirements. Leading industrial water
chiller manufacturers help evaluate these factors and recommend the ideal industrial air chiller or
water-based cooling solution for maximum performance and long-term savings.

What is an Air Cooled Chiller?

An air cooled water chiller is a cooling system that removes heat from industrial processes using
ambient air instead of water. It uses condenser fans to dissipate heat, making installation simple
and maintenance cost-effective. As experienced air cooled chiller manufacturers, we design highly
efficient air cooled chillers suitable for manufacturing units, pharmaceutical plants, food
processing facilities, plastic industries, and commercial buildings.

What is the difference between Air Cooled and Water Cooled Chillers?

The primary difference lies in the method of heat rejection. Air cooled chillers use surrounding air
to cool the condenser, making them easier to install and ideal for locations with limited water
availability. Water-cooled chillers use cooling towers and water circulation, offering higher
efficiency for large-scale operations. Choosing the right system depends on your cooling
requirements, operating environment, energy goals, and available infrastructure.

Which industries require Industrial Cooling?

Industrial cooling is essential wherever machinery or production processes generate excessive heat.
Industries such as pharmaceuticals, plastics, chemicals, food and beverage, dairy, printing,
textiles, packaging, metal processing, automotive, and HVAC manufacturing depend on efficient
industrial cooling solutions to maintain product quality, improve equipment life, and ensure
uninterrupted operations.

What capacity chillers do you manufacture?

We manufacture industrial chillers in a wide range of cooling capacities to meet the requirements of
both small-scale and large industrial applications. Whether you need a compact industrial air
chiller or a high-capacity cooling system for continuous production, our engineering team delivers
reliable and energy-efficient solutions tailored to your operational needs.

Do you provide customized cooling solutions?

Yes. We specialize in designing customized industrial cooling solutions based on your industry,
production process, cooling load, temperature requirements, and available installation space. Our
experienced engineers develop tailor-made systems that maximize efficiency, reduce operating costs,
and deliver dependable long-term performance for diverse industrial applications.

Do you export worldwide?

Yes. We supply high-quality industrial cooling equipment to customers across international markets.
As a trusted air cooled chiller supplier and one of the reliable industrial water chiller
manufacturers, we ensure every system meets international quality standards while providing complete
technical support, documentation, and timely delivery for global clients.

What is a Chiller Plant?

A chiller plant is a centralized cooling system that produces chilled water and distributes it
throughout an industrial or commercial facility for process cooling or air conditioning. It consists
of chillers, pumps, piping, controls, and heat exchangers working together to provide efficient and
consistent cooling. Properly designed chiller plants significantly reduce energy consumption and
improve operational reliability.

How does a Cold Room Work?

A cold room maintains a controlled low-temperature environment using refrigeration equipment that
continuously removes heat from the enclosed space. High-quality insulation minimizes heat transfer,
while precise temperature controls ensure products remain fresh and protected. Cold rooms are widely
used for storing food products, pharmaceuticals, chemicals, dairy items, and other

## Who We Are

### Our Vision: To be the region’s **most recognized, trusted and respected** full service
### facilities experts

With over five decades of expertise and a leading presence in the industry, AMS is a regional
mechanical contractor specializing in the design, installation, and service of heating, ventilation,
air conditioning, and plumbing systems for commercial, industrial, and institutional clients. Our
specialties include plumbing and process piping, sheet metal fabrication, MEP, system retrofits,
service, controls, design-build, plan & spec, and fast-track projects.

AMS brings a broad blend of expertise to our customers. Our combination of experience, advanced
technology, and customer-focused service allows us to find new and better ways to meet your needs
quickly and cost-effectively. The result? Services that keep your business up and running, with
support that builds long-lasting relationships.

Our mission is to lead the mechanical construction industry with continuous growth and profitability
by providing our employees with an honest and collaborative work environment—one where they can
dedicate themselves to delivering exceptional workmanship and extraordinary customer service.

[ Learn More ][37]

## Our Expertise

### Services that keep your business up and running and support that builds long-lasting
### relationships.

### Design + Build

Bring our expertise in-house. Our engineering department is among the industry’s most respected-
offering the scale, experience, and talent to support your operations. With professional engineers
and skilled CAD operators on staff, AMS provides a seamless in-house resource from concept to
completion.

[Learn More][38]

### Mechanical Construction

AMS partners with architects and certified in-house engineers on new construction, additions, and
renovations. From concept to completion, we ensure your project incorporates the latest in digital
control systems, LEED standards, and green technologies. By combining innovation with seamless
implementation, we deliver reliable mechanical systems built to perform today and endure well into
the future.

[Learn More][39]

### Sheet Metal Fabrication

With in-house engineering, design, and fabrication, AMS operates its own sheet metal facility
staffed by skilled craftsmen. This allows us to engineer, fabricate, and install the precise
ductwork required for both new construction and upgraded MEP systems, delivering efficiency,
quality, and reliability every step of the way. 

[Learn More][40]

### PLUMBING + PIPEFITTING

To ensure your plumbing systems are designed, installed, and maintained to the highest standards,
AMS provides a dedicated team of professional plumbers and pipefitters. Our in-house experts have
extensive experience across a wide range of products and systems, allowing us to deliver reliable
solutions and serve as your single source for service and support. 

[Learn More][41]

### Building Systems Integrator 

AMS ensures sure your heating, ventilating and air conditioning systems are designed and built for
long-term reliability and maximum return on investment. Our team develops solutions that increase
energy efficiency, enhance indoor air quality monitoring, and create healthier, more comfortable
environments for your employees. 

[Learn More][42]

### MEP Services

As a full-service mechanical contractor, AMS delivers integrated mechanical, electrical and plumbing
solutions tailored to each project's requirements. 

[Learn More][43]

## Solid Experience, Innovative Technology, Customer Focus

As a mechanical contractor specializing in MEP and plumbing solutions, AMS brings a broad blend of
expertise to commercial, industrial and institutional customers. It’s a combination of experience,
advanced technology and customer-focused service that lets us find new and better ways to meet your
needs quickly and cost-effectively. The result? Services that keep your business up and running and
support that builds long-lasting relationships.

## Who We Are

### Our Vision: To be the region’s **most recognized, trusted and respected** full service
### facilities experts

With over five decades of expertise and a leading presence in the industry, AMS is a regional
mechanical contractor specializing in the design, installation, and service of heating, ventilation,
air conditioning, and plumbing systems for commercial, industrial, and institutional clients. Our
specialties include plumbing and process piping, sheet metal fabrication, MEP, system retrofits,
service, controls, design-build, plan & spec, and fast-track projects.

AMS brings a broad blend of expertise to our customers. Our combination of experience, advanced
technology, and customer-focused service allows us to find new and better ways to meet your needs
quickly and cost-effectively. The result? Services that keep your business up and running, with
support that builds long-lasting relationships.

Our mission is to lead the mechanical construction industry with continuous growth and profitability
by providing our employees with an honest and collaborative work environment—one where they can
dedicate themselves to delivering exceptional workmanship and extraordinary customer service.

[ Learn More ][37]

## Our Expertise

### Services that keep your business up and running and support that builds long-lasting
### relationships.

### Design + Build

Bring our expertise in-house. Our engineering department is among the industry’s most respected-
offering the scale, experience, and talent to support your operations. With professional engineers
and skilled CAD operators on staff, AMS provides a seamless in-house resource from concept to
completion.

[Learn More][38]

### Mechanical Construction

AMS partners with architects and certified in-house engineers on new construction, additions, and
renovations. From concept to completion, we ensure your project incorporates the latest in digital
control systems, LEED standards, and green technologies. By combining innovation with seamless
implementation, we deliver reliable mechanical systems built to perform today and endure well into
the future.

[Learn More][39]

### Sheet Metal Fabrication

With in-house engineering, design, and fabrication, AMS operates its own sheet metal facility
staffed by skilled craftsmen. This allows us to engineer, fabricate, and install the precise
ductwork required for both new construction and upgraded MEP systems, delivering efficiency,
quality, and reliability every step of the way. 

[Learn More][40]

### PLUMBING + PIPEFITTING

To ensure your plumbing systems are designed, installed, and maintained to the highest standards,
AMS provides a dedicated team of professional plumbers and pipefitters. Our in-house experts have
extensive experience across a wide range of products and systems, allowing us to deliver reliable
solutions and serve as your single source for service and support. 

[Learn More][41]

### Building Systems Integrator 

AMS ensures sure your heating, ventilating and air conditioning systems are designed and built for
long-term reliability and maximum return on investment. Our team develops solutions that increase
energy efficiency, enhance indoor air quality monitoring, and create healthier, more comfortable
environments for your employees. 

[Learn More][42]

### MEP Services

As a full-service mechanical contractor, AMS delivers integrated mechanical, electrical and plumbing
solutions tailored to each project's requirements. 

[Learn More][43]

## Solid Experience, Innovative Technology, Customer Focus

As a mechanical contractor specializing in MEP and plumbing solutions, AMS brings a broad blend of
expertise to commercial, industrial and institutional customers. It’s a combination of experience,
advanced technology and customer-focused service that lets us find new and better ways to meet your
needs quickly and cost-effectively. The result? Services that keep your business up and running and
support that builds long-lasting relationships.

Cooling Tower Manufacturer — Malaysia

# Industrial Cooling Solutions Built for Performance

BHL Cooling Tower designs, manufactures, and supplies high-efficiency cooling towers for power
plants, industrial facilities, and commercial projects across Southeast Asia.

[Speak to an Expert ][16] [View Services][17]
[What is a Cooling Tower?][18] [Request a Quotation][19] [Maintenance & Retrofit][20]
Project Portfolio

## Applications We Cool

From skyline HVAC systems to heavy industrial processes — our cooling towers are engineered for the
demands of each application.

[
Commercial

### HVAC

Comfort cooling for offices, malls, hospitals and mixed-use developments.

][21] [
Industrial

### Industrial Processes

Process cooling for manufacturing, plastics, food & beverage and chemical plants.

][22] [
Lifecycle

### After-Market Services

Retrofit, refurbishment, commissioning and ongoing performance maintenance.

][23]
Products & Services

## What We Do

From new installations to full retrofits, BHL Cooling Tower delivers cooling tower solutions
tailored to your project scope and budget.

### Cooling Tower Retrofit

Upgrade your existing cooling tower without full replacement. We assess, redesign, and replace
ageing components — fill media, fan systems, drift eliminators, and structure — to restore peak
thermal performance and extend equipment life.
* Fill Media Replacement
* Fan & Motor Upgrade
* Structural Refurbishment
* Performance Testing

### Custom Made Cooling Tower

Not every project is a catalogue. We engineer cooling towers to your exact thermal load, site
dimensions, noise limits, and water quality requirements — from single cell FRP units to large
multi-cell structures.
* Thermal Sizing to Spec
* Custom Footprint & Height
* Material Selection
* Full Engineering Documentation

### New Cooling Tower

Supply and installation of new FRP, crossflow or counterflow cooling towers for commercial,
industrial, and power plant applications. Factory-direct pricing with full technical support from
selection through commissioning.
* FRP / Crossflow / Counterflow
* 10 RT - 3,000 RT Capacity
* Supply & Installation
* Commissioning Support

### Not sure what you need?

Speak to our engineers — we'll help you select the right solution for your application, project
budget, and timeline.

[Speak to an Expert ][24]
Industries We Serve

## Trusted Across Multiple Sectors

Our cooling towers are deployed in demanding environments across Malaysia and Southeast Asia.

#### MEP Contractors

M&E project supply, technical specs, fast delivery

#### Property Developers

Commercial & mixed-use HVAC cooling infrastructure

#### Power Plants

High-capacity heat rejection for turbine condensers

#### Production Factories

Process cooling for machinery, compressors, processes

#### Food & Beverage Industry

Hygienic closed-loop systems, food-safe compliance

#### Plastic Industry

Injection moulding and extrusion process cooling

#### Chiller Manufacturers

OEM-ready cooling tower integration and bundling

#### SME Owners

Affordable, right-sized cooling for small operations

Why Choose BHL

## The BHL Advantage

We combine local manufacturing capability with engineering depth to deliver cooling solutions that
perform in real-world Southeast Asian conditions.

### Local Manufacturer

Fully manufactured in Malaysia — shorter lead times, lower freight costs, and direct engineering
support.

### Custom Engineering

We design to your thermal performance data — not just catalogue sizes. Custom configurations
available for non-standard applications.

### Technical After-Sales

Dedicated service team for commissioning, maintenance contracts, and emergency breakdown support.

### Quality Materials

Premium-grade FRP, stainless steel hardware, and certified PVC fill media — built to withstand
Malaysian tropical conditions.

### Fast Project Turnaround

Streamlined production scheduling and logistics to meet tight project timelines for contractors and
developers.

### Competitive Pricing

Factory-direct pricing with no middlemen. Transparent quotations with full technical documentation.

Contact Us

## Get a Free Technical Quote

Tell us your project requirements and our engineers will prepare a detailed proposal with product
recommendation, thermal sizing, and pricing — at no obligation.

# Treating Water

## Clarification & Biological Treatment Solutions

[Water & Wastewater Products][213]
[A close-up view of a large concrete cooling tower against a backdrop of a partly cloudy sky, with a
metal ladder and platform attached to the side stretching upwards towards the top of the structure.]

## Keep It Cool

### It’s What’s Inside Your Tower That Matters

[Cooling Tower Products][214]
[A scientist wearing a lab coat and blue gloves holds a multi-well plate filled with samples.
Various test tubes containing colorful liquids are organized on the lab bench in the foreground.]

## Protect With Confidence

### Custom Medical Packaging & Components

[Medical Products][215]
[A yellow and green leaf lies on wet pavement, partially submerged in a puddle near the curb.
Raindrops create splashes around the leaf.]

## Expect Results

### Pretreating & Managing Stormwater

[Stormwater Management Products][216]
[A row of industrial batteries arranged symmetrically in a brightly lit room. Each battery is fitted
with red and black terminals, with cables attached.]

## Powering Up

### Solutions for Industrial-Grade Batteries

[Battery Products][217]
[A close-up shot of the handle and upper body of a Brentwood wheelbarrow on a grassy surface. The
image focuses on the handle's wooden grip and a portion of the metal tub, with a blurred background
of greenery.]

## Building Together

### Professional-Grade Tools to Make Any Job Successful

[Construction Products][218]
[A sprawling industrial complex with numerous brightly lit structures and tanks is seen next to a
river, under a sunset sky.]

## Preserving The Environment

### Water & Air Treatment Solutions

[Mass Transfer Products][219]
[Close-up of the edge of a large stack of paper or a roll of paper, with the tightly packed sheets
creating a series of curved lines. The lighting is soft, evoking a warm home feel, with a blue tone
on the left and a brighter, whiter light on the right.]

## Customized Confidence

### Thermoforming & Injection Molding Services

[Custom Solutions][220]

## Who We Are

### Taking on Challenges Since 1965

In the early days of Brentwood, the shop was full of small, custom plastics jobs. Manufacturing
equipment included two homemade formers, with roughly a half dozen employees to run them. Our
primary focus was creating solutions for whatever our customers needed.

While the company has grown tremendously since then, with hundreds of employees stationed across the
globe and operating from seven different countries, we uphold that spirit – taking on projects big
and small, simple and complex, to find solutions for our customers’ challenges.

[Explore Brentwood][221]
[an image of Brentwood Industries headquarters]

## Who We Help

### Explore the Industries We Serve

[
[Close-up of large industrial pipes with water cascading through a metal mesh structure. The pipes,
carrying wastewater, are supported by a network of cables, creating a complex yet organized
arrangement.]
Water & Wastewater

With a comprehensive knowledge of the water and wastewater treatment processes and an in-depth
understanding of diverse applications, Brentwood provides systems for clarification and biological
treatment to improve efficiency and meet site-specific goals.

][222] [
[A close-up view of three power plant cooling towers emitting white steam against a clear blue sky.]
Cooling Tower

designed to provide long-lasting performance in industrial and commercial applications.

][223] [
[a person wearing blue gloves and a white protective lab coat, working under a bright lamp, holding
a clear plastic container]
Medical

By providing the medical industry with innovative design services and cutting-edge manufacturing
processes, Brentwood is able to produce thermoformed packaging and injection molded components that
increase efficiency and reduce costs.

][224] [
[A close-up view of several black film fills in a wavy pattern, reminiscent of cross-fluted fills.
The image focuses on the shapes and edges of the sheets, with a blurred background.]
Building & Construction

Whether you’re a landscaper, a contractor, or a do-it-yourselfer, Brentwood can supply you with
professional-grade tools to make any job successful. These include wheelbarrows, mortar products,
and attic ventilation systems.

][225] [
[a wet road with rain droplets creating ripples on the water.]
Stormwater

StormTank products are designed to provide strong, affordable stormwater management solutions. By
allowing for pretreatment and offering underground storage options, this product line protects our
environment and creates developable space.

## About Us


At the Cooling Technology Institute, our mission is to advocate and promote the use of all
environmentally responsible commercial cooling technologies. From information exchanges to dialogs
on the benefits of different cooling technologies with government agencies the world over, we work
hard to present a forum that unites manufacturers, suppliers, and owners and operators with a single
voice dedicated to safety and innovation. Learn more about who we are and the work we do every day.

[ Learn More ][86]

### Become a Member

[Register Now][87]

You can have a say in the forum that governs your industry. Whether you represent a corporation that
delivers cooling towers, a single plant operating an industrial evaporative heat transfer system, a
firm of water treatment experts, or a parts supplier of any size, your voice can be heard by your
peers, industry veterans, and decision-makers. Join a committee. Submit a paper. Get involved.
That’s CTI Membership.

## About Us


At the Cooling Technology Institute, our mission is to advocate and promote the use of all
environmentally responsible commercial cooling technologies. From information exchanges to dialogs
on the benefits of different cooling technologies with government agencies the world over, we work
hard to present a forum that unites manufacturers, suppliers, and owners and operators with a single
voice dedicated to safety and innovation. Learn more about who we are and the work we do every day.

[ Learn More ][86]

### Become a Member

[Register Now][87]

You can have a say in the forum that governs your industry. Whether you represent a corporation that
delivers cooling towers, a single plant operating an industrial evaporative heat transfer system, a
firm of water treatment experts, or a parts supplier of any size, your voice can be heard by your
peers, industry veterans, and decision-makers. Join a committee. Submit a paper. Get involved.
That’s CTI Membership.

## Cooler Master ESG

In response to the Paris Agreement, Cooler Master has established group-level greenhouse gas (GHG)
reduction targets, decarbonization pathways, and transition strategies. Our science-based targets
were officially validated by the Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi). Through continuous
decarbonization efforts, we have achieved meaningful progress: in 2024, our absolute GHG emissions
were approximately 59% lower than the 2022 base year, demonstrating steady advancement along our
science-based reduction pathway.

## Cooler Master ESG

reduction targets, decarbonization pathways, and transition strategies. Our science-based targets
were officially validated by the Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi). Through continuous
decarbonization efforts, we have achieved meaningful progress: in 2024, our absolute GHG emissions
were approximately 59% lower than the 2022 base year, demonstrating steady advancement along our
science-based reduction pathway.

## [More Cooling Tower Manufacturers][71]


### Cooling Tower Supplier Directory Overview

At Cooling Towers, buyers can find and compare cooling tower manufacturers, browse cooling tower
suppliers, and connect with cooling tower companies serving demanding industrial and commercial
applications. This directory helps sourcing teams evaluate industrial cooling towers, commercial
cooling towers, and related system options for power generation, manufacturing, HVAC, food
processing, chemical handling, and other heat-intensive operations. Whether you need to source
standard units or application-specific systems, this page is built to help users compare
capabilities, review equipment types, and identify cooling tower manufacturers in the USA that match
operating conditions, throughput goals, and installation requirements.

### Open Cooling Towers vs Closed Loop Systems

Open cooling towers are widely used when facilities need efficient evaporative heat rejection for
large circulating water loops. Buyers often browse these systems for industrial cooling towers in
power generation, heavy manufacturing, refineries, and large HVAC operations because they support
consistent heat removal and scalable plant performance. Closed loop systems are often sourced when
process fluid protection matters, especially in chemical processing, pharmaceutical production, food
manufacturing, and applications where contamination control and water quality affect output.

### Counterflow and Crossflow Cooling Tower Designs

Counterflow and crossflow designs serve different airflow and maintenance preferences, so buyers
comparing cooling tower manufacturers often review both styles side by side. Counterflow units are
frequently selected for compact industrial cooling solutions where vertical airflow supports thermal
performance in tighter layouts. Crossflow units are commonly considered for commercial cooling tower
installations, institutional facilities, and larger building systems where accessibility,
serviceability, and water distribution patterns influence the final specification.

### Industrial vs Commercial Cooling Tower Applications

Industrial water cooling towers are commonly evaluated for process cooling, recirculating water
loops, chiller support, and continuous-duty thermal management. These systems are used in steel
processing, plastics production, pulp and paper, and petrochemical operations where equipment
temperatures must remain stable under variable loads. Commercial cooling towers, by contrast, are
more often tied to large building HVAC systems, district cooling applications, healthcare campuses,
data facilities, and other environments where dependable heat rejection supports comfort, uptime,
and energy control.

### Industry Applications of Cooling Towers

Power plants depend on cooling towers to handle condenser loads and maintain reliable thermal
performance across continuous operating cycles. Chemical processors need industrial cooling towers
that can support heat-sensitive reactions and protect equipment from unstable temperatures. Food and
beverage facilities use closed loop or sanitary-conscious cooling support for process control and
refrigeration efficiency. Data centers and large commercial buildings rely on commercial cooling
towers to support chillers and prevent system overheating. Plastics, pulp, and metalworking
operations need durable cooling tower systems that match production schedules, water conditions, and
plant utility demands.

### How to Size and Select a Cooling Tower

Buyers should begin by matching cooling tower capacity to production volume, recirculation rate, and
thermal load. A system sized for occasional peaks may not support continuous throughput, while an
oversized unit can add unnecessary operating cost. When comparing cooling tower manufacturers, it
helps to define heat rejection requirements early so supplier discussions stay focused on real
process demand.

### Process Type and System Design Considerations

Process type matters just as much as size. Open systems may fit applications where direct
evaporative cooling is acceptable, while closed loop designs are often better for cleaner fluid
separation and more controlled operation. Buyers researching industrial cooling solutions should
also compare ambient conditions, water quality, and expected seasonal performance before narrowing
the field.

### Integration and Installation Requirements

Integration questions can quickly separate a general cooling tower supplier from a specialized one.
Piping layout, pump compatibility, structural footprint, fan access, basin configuration, and line
controls all affect how easily a system fits into an existing process or HVAC loop. Cooling tower
manufacturers in USA markets are often evaluated on how well they support retrofit conditions, not
just new installations.

### Inspection, Certification, and Compliance

### Cooling Tower Supplier Directory Overview

At Cooling Towers, buyers can find and compare cooling tower manufacturers, browse cooling tower
suppliers, and connect with cooling tower companies serving demanding industrial and commercial
applications. This directory helps sourcing teams evaluate industrial cooling towers, commercial

capabilities, review equipment types, and identify cooling tower manufacturers in the USA that match
operating conditions, throughput goals, and installation requirements.

### Open Cooling Towers vs Closed Loop Systems

Open cooling towers are widely used when facilities need efficient evaporative heat rejection for
large circulating water loops. Buyers often browse these systems for industrial cooling towers in
power generation, heavy manufacturing, refineries, and large HVAC operations because they support
consistent heat removal and scalable plant performance. Closed loop systems are often sourced when
process fluid protection matters, especially in chemical processing, pharmaceutical production, food
manufacturing, and applications where contamination control and water quality affect output.

### Counterflow and Crossflow Cooling Tower Designs

Counterflow and crossflow designs serve different airflow and maintenance preferences, so buyers
comparing cooling tower manufacturers often review both styles side by side. Counterflow units are
frequently selected for compact industrial cooling solutions where vertical airflow supports thermal
performance in tighter layouts. Crossflow units are commonly considered for commercial cooling tower
installations, institutional facilities, and larger building systems where accessibility,
serviceability, and water distribution patterns influence the final specification.

### Industrial vs Commercial Cooling Tower Applications

Industrial water cooling towers are commonly evaluated for process cooling, recirculating water
loops, chiller support, and continuous-duty thermal management. These systems are used in steel
processing, plastics production, pulp and paper, and petrochemical operations where equipment
temperatures must remain stable under variable loads. Commercial cooling towers, by contrast, are
more often tied to large building HVAC systems, district cooling applications, healthcare campuses,
data facilities, and other environments where dependable heat rejection supports comfort, uptime,
and energy control.

### Industry Applications of Cooling Towers

Power plants depend on cooling towers to handle condenser loads and maintain reliable thermal
performance across continuous operating cycles. Chemical processors need industrial cooling towers
that can support heat-sensitive reactions and protect equipment from unstable temperatures. Food and
beverage facilities use closed loop or sanitary-conscious cooling support for process control and
refrigeration efficiency. Data centers and large commercial buildings rely on commercial cooling
towers to support chillers and prevent system overheating. Plastics, pulp, and metalworking
operations need durable cooling tower systems that match production schedules, water conditions, and
plant utility demands.

Buyers should begin by matching cooling tower capacity to production volume, recirculation rate, and
thermal load. A system sized for occasional peaks may not support continuous throughput, while an
oversized unit can add unnecessary operating cost. When comparing cooling tower manufacturers, it
helps to define heat rejection requirements early so supplier discussions stay focused on real
process demand.

### Process Type and System Design Considerations

Process type matters just as much as size. Open systems may fit applications where direct
evaporative cooling is acceptable, while closed loop designs are often better for cleaner fluid
separation and more controlled operation. Buyers researching industrial cooling solutions should
also compare ambient conditions, water quality, and expected seasonal performance before narrowing
the field.

### Integration and Installation Requirements

Integration questions can quickly separate a general cooling tower supplier from a specialized one.
Piping layout, pump compatibility, structural footprint, fan access, basin configuration, and line
controls all affect how easily a system fits into an existing process or HVAC loop. Cooling tower
manufacturers in USA markets are often evaluated on how well they support retrofit conditions, not
just new installations.

## Installation, Repair, Maintenance & Upgrade Specialists

We are proud to introduce you to the latest and greatest in cooling tower installation, repair,
maintenance and upgrades. **Cooling Towers LLC** is a young, strong and driven company headed by
employees with values that reflect the company’s mission statement. It is our goal to provide

## FanLock - Patented Mechanical Equipment Locking System

[ [services_circles10] ][38]

### [Tower inspections][39]

Cooling Towers LLC provides comprehensive and thorough inspections of wood, fiberglass, steel and
concrete cooling towers. If you are in doubt about the soundness of the structure of your cooling
tower then a thorough inspection and a structural analysis may be needed.

[Learn More][40]
[ [repairs_circles] ][41]

### [Cooling Tower Repairs][42]

Cooling Towers LLC utilizes the highest quality pressure treated Redwood lumber, Douglas fir lumber,
plywood, fiberglass and stainless steel hardware in performing repairs. The use of quality materials
along with competent crews and professional installation ensures the structural stability of your
cooling tower while greatly extending its service life.

[Learn More][43]
[ [cooling tower mechanical walkways] ][44]

### [Mechanical Walkways][45]

Mechanical platforms provide access around mechanical equipment during maintenance and mechanical
repairs. These platforms also prevent the need to constantly install and remove costly scaffolding.
Our platforms are constructed of corrosion/rot resistant FRP components.

[Learn More][46]
[ [NEWTOWERC_circles] ][47]

### [New Tower construction][48]

Cooling Towers LLC provides all necessary services for designing (thermal and structural),
procuring, and installing new cooling towers. We also offer both packaged towers for commercial
applications as well as field-installed towers for larger, industrial applications.

[Learn More][49]

## A Message From Our President

[Brochure Shawn Bubble]

I am proud to introduce you to the latest and greatest in cooling tower installation, repair,
maintenance and upgrades. Cooling Towers LLC is a young, strong and driven company headed by
employees with values that reflect the company’s mission statement. It is our goal to provide
superior quality and service at fair and reasonable prices to all our customers.

Our management team has over 100 years combined experience and our crews are the most competent and
qualified in the industry. For all phases of cooling tower construction, repair, maintenance, or
performance upgrades, Cooling Towers LLC truly is the one source for all your cooling tower needs.

Our clients include Major Manufacturing and Process Plants, Refineries, Hospitals, Petro Chemical,
Universities, Co-Generation facilities and Commercial Buildings.

### - Shawn Daniel

Delta’s new factory, equipped with the largest molding equipment of its kind in North America, is
now producing the new TMX Series Cooling Tower! The tower sump is molded from HDPE in a single,
continuous piece over 20 feet long, eliminating joints, seams, or welds that are prone to leaks and
maintenance issues. Available in 300-3250 tons.

The bestselling TM Series™ Cooling Towers Delta's TM Series™ induces draft, offering a counter flow
design. The towers, are available in single unit capacities, ranging from 200 - 1000+ tons.

Private Limited**. Our company was formed many years ago for rendering the best-in-class HVAC

success with cost-efficient services and products. We are operating across markets as a
**manufacturer **and **service provider **in HVAC segment. Our company has adopted groundbreaking
techniques to continue processing exceptional ducts and cooling systems.
We are a key player that renders a comprehensive gamut of solutions to meet specific needs of the
commercial and industrial partners. Our team possesses a great knowledge to manufacture ducts in
several shapes to meet individual needs. The products we offer are **Spiral Duct, Evaporative
Cooling System, Round Duct, **etc.

# API Inspection & API 579 Fitness for Service Assessment

**Inspection 4 Industry LLC** provides API inspection training and API 579 Fitness for Service
Assessment (FFS) services for the oil and gas and process industries, supporting pressure vessels,
piping systems, and aboveground storage tanks.

I4I Academy provides Online API Inspector Training Courses, including API 510 pressure vessel
inspector training course, API 570 piping inspector training course, API 653 aboveground storage
tank inspector training course, API Source inspector training course, API 1104 welding of pipelines
and related facilities training course, API 571 Corrosion and Materials training course, and API 580
Risk Based Inspection training course. Multiple ASME courses are also provided, including courses
about ASME Section VIII Div.1, IX, and V.

Inspection 4 Industry LLC provides [API 579 Fitness for Service Assessment][170] (FFS) services for
common damage mechanisms (metal loss, pitting, cracking, hydrogen damage, dents and gouges, fire
damage, creep, laminations, fatigue, and more). If API 579 FFS is needed for your equipment, contact
Inspection 4 Industry LLC and we can perform the assessment and deliver a complete engineering
report with a clear fit-for-service decision and any required operating limits.


## API Inspection Training Courses

Welcome to the [I4I Academy][171], where our online API Inspector Training courses stand out with an
unparalleled success rate in API Individual Certification Program Exams. We take pride in achieving
a remarkable pass rate of over 95% for participants in our API 510, API 570, and API 653 training
courses, with the majority succeeding in their certification exams on the very first attempt.

through the course.

exam, functioning as a mock-up of the API certification exam. This simulation enables students to
experience exam conditions, refine their time-management skills, and gauge their readiness for the

proceed with their studies at their own pace, ensuring a personalized and stress-free learning
journey. We recognize that every individual has a unique learning style and schedule, and our
courses are tailored to accommodate these differences.

professionals who have not only gained valuable knowledge but have also achieved certification
excellence. Your success is our priority, and our courses are crafted to guide you towards a
fulfilling and rewarding career in API inspection.

## API 579 Fitness for Service Assessment (FFS)

Inspection 4 Industry LLC provides API 579 Fitness for Service Assessment (FFS) services and a
complete set of online screening tools to help you quickly identify the most appropriate API 579
Part for your damage condition and determine whether a formal FFS evaluation is likely needed.

Our API 579 screening tools are organized by damage mechanism and structured by Part, so you can
follow a clear workflow for each assessment topic—including Part 3 [Brittle Fracture][204], Part 4
[General Metal Loss][205], Part 5 [Local Metal Loss][206], Part 6 [Pitting Corrosion][207], Part 7
[Hydrogen Damage][208], Part 8 [Weld Misalignment and Shell Distortions][209], Part 9 [Crack-Like
Flaws][210], Part 10 [Creep][211], Part 11 [Fire Damage][212], Part 12 [Dents and Gouges][213]
(including dent-gouge combinations), Part 13 [Laminations][214], and Part 14 [Fatigue][215]. Each
tool is designed to be practical for real inspection data and to guide you toward the correct next
step without guessing.

If your screening result indicates that API 579 Fitness for Service Assessment (FFS) is needed,
Inspection 4 Industry LLC can perform the engineering evaluation and deliver a complete report with

Assessment (FFS) services for the oil and gas and process industries, supporting pressure vessels,

inspector training course, API 570 piping inspector training course, API 653 aboveground storage

and related facilities training course, API 571 Corrosion and Materials training course, and API 580

about ASME Section VIII Div.1, IX, and V.

# Sistemi di raffreddamento per lo scambio termico

I tuoi consulenti del raffreddamento di processo. Produttori di torri di raffreddamento,
raffreddatori adiabatici, dry cooler, condensatori evaporativi e chiller. Risparmio energia e acqua
grazie alle molteplici soluzioni e alle simulazioni dei nostri software comparativi.

## La nostra gamma di prodotti
* [

  richiesto dall’Intelligenza Artificiale (AI) e dal traffico dati globale sta rendendo i sistemi di
  raffreddamento ad aria tradizionali non più sufficienti. La transizione verso il raffreddamento a
  liquido è spesso una necessità per gestire carichi termici ad alta densità, e la Cooling
  Distribution Unit (CDU) ne rappresenta il componente fondamentale.
  
  ][126]

# Your Nationwide Partner for Every Cooling Tower Need

Rebuild & Repair, Service & Maintenance, Inspections, and Parts-handled by one team.

## Our Core Services

At OBR Cooling Towers, we provide a comprehensive range of services to ensure your cooling systems
operate at peak performance. From proactive maintenance to custom-built solutions, our expertise
ensures longevity, efficiency, and reliability for your cooling towers. Whether you need routine
inspections, new installations, repairs, or high-quality replacement parts, our team is committed to
delivering the best solutions for your industry needs.

### Service Group

Cleanings, preventative maintenance, and documentation for performance optimization.

[optimize your cooling system][15]

### Rebuild & Repairs

Tower upgrades, structural repairs, and installation for all makes and models.

[discover custom cooling solutions][16]

### Parts Warehouse

High-quality, ready-to-ship OEM and after-market cooling tower components.

[find the right cooling tower parts][17]
[OBR CoilCare. OBR tech power washing coils]

### CoilCare™

Professional coil cleaning that helps improve HVAC performance and extend equipment life.

[View CoilCare™ Services][18]

## Inspections

Examination of critical mechanical components, structural integrity, and safety requirements.

[prevent failures before they happen][19]

## What Sets Us Apart

#### Trusted Nationwide. Built on Precision. Backed by People Who Care.

At OBR Cooling Towers, we don’t just build and service towers—we build long-term partnerships rooted
in trust, performance, and accountability. With over 30 years of experience and a coast-to-coast
presence, we deliver solutions that keep your systems efficient, safe, and reliable.

### In-House Engineering & Fabrication

Our dedicated team of mechanical engineers and fabricators delivers tailored solutions with
precision and speed—no outsourcing, no delays.

### Nationwide Service Coverage

With regional hubs and field crews across the U.S., we’re ready to respond wherever your towers are
located.

### Comprehensive Services Under One Roof

From inspections and maintenance to full tower builds and custom parts—we do it all, simplifying
vendor management for your team.

### Vertically Integrated Logistics

Our internal logistics operation ensures faster delivery of materials and components—reducing
downtime and project delays.

### Certified Safety Culture (HEIGHTS Program)

We prioritize the safety of your site and our people through rigorous planning, training, and
adherence to the highest safety standards.

### Responsive, Detail-Driven Support

We go beyond the job—we provide clear communication, thorough reporting, and long-term solutions
that keep your systems running strong.

## About OBR Cooling Towers

With over 30 years of experience, OBR Cooling Towers has grown into a nationwide leader in cooling
tower solutions, supporting critical infrastructure across refineries, power generation, healthcare,
data centers, industrial facilities, and beyond. Backed by a team of 450+ employees across 10+
locations, we deliver the scale, speed, and technical expertise our customers rely on.

Our vertically integrated model includes engineering, inspections, parts supply, field services,
custom fabrication, logistics, and preventative maintenance—allowing us to provide full-service
solutions that maximize reliability, extend equipment life, and reduce downtime.

[OBR's Mission][20]

## Industries We Serve

OBR has solutions for any industrial application.

## Data Centers

## Commercial Buildings

## Industrial Facilities

## Campuses

## Multi-Family Housing

## Healthcare Facilities

## Nationwide Reach. Local Support.

We proudly serve the entire continental U.S. with strategically located service hubs.

[OBR Construction Sales Engineers Territory Map]

## Your Nationwide Construction Team

Our Construction Team is built for precision, safety, and results. No matter where your project is
located. From modular builds to complex field-erected towers, our experienced crews deliver
high-quality cooling tower construction tailored to your site’s specific needs.

[speak to a construction expert][21]

## Your Nationwide Service Team

Meet the OBR Service Team. Your trusted partners for reliable cooling tower support across the
country. Wherever you're located, our dedicated experts are ready to deliver responsive maintenance,
repairs, inspections, and emergency service to keep your systems running at peak performance.

[speak to a service expert][22]
[OBR Service Engineers Territory Map]

#### Quick links

[OBR Newsroom][23]

[Apply Now][24]

[Refund Policy][25]

[Shipping Policy][26]

[Privacy Policy][2

* Corrosion-resistant FRP construction ensures extended service life.

* UV-stable resins resist degradation—even in direct sunlight.

exposure. With minimal maintenance requirements, they deliver stable and reliable performance for
years to come.

* **HVAC & Climate Control:** Distilleries, sugar mills, water-cooled air conditioning, VAM systems,
  and cold storage units.
* **Plastics & Manufacturing:** Plastic injection and blow molding, die casting, iron foundries,
  rolling mills, and wire drawing units.
* **Chemical & Pharmaceutical:** Ideal for chemical processing, pharmaceutical plants, anodizing,
  heat treatment, and refineries.
* **Food & Beverage:** Dairy cooling, juice and food processing, canning lines, and packaging units.
* **Energy & Utilities:** Reliable cooling for oxygen plants, bio gas units, renewable energy, and
  gasification systems.
* **General Industry:** Water-cooled compressors, vacuum pumps, knitting/hosiery units, and multiple
  industrial setups.

PERFECT Cooling Towers are trusted across industries for their adaptability and
performance—delivering consistent cooling in diverse operating environments.

Tonisco’s hot tapping and line stopping technology keeps your networks fully operational. We deliver
high-quality products and expert services to maintain and modify your pressurized pipelines — all
without the need for service shutdowns.

## Products

Tonisco System manufactures high-quality hot tapping and line stopping products for repairing and
modifying pressurized pipelines. With the use of Tonisco hot tap and line stop products these
repairs and modifications can be done without service shutdowns, which is time efficient and more
sustainable.

## Services

Tonisco Service provides hot tapping, line stopping and other services for pipeline repairs and
modifications all under pressure without service shutdowns, and in a more sustainable way. Tonisco
staff makes sure that the work is completed on time, with customer satisfaction and in a
professional manner.

Given the wide array of products we specialize in, our services cater to three additional aspects
namely, cooling tower maintenance, customization and upgradation, and single product distribution of
cooling tower parts. The sole intention is to provide our customers a one-stop shop for all cooling

Why search for a group of handyman when our services are top-notch? We operate 24*7 for the

efficient, and timely maintenance and keep your investment in good condition.

the cooling towers.

  back on-line in the shortest amount of time.

# Efficient by Design Through *Innovative Cooling* Technology

Tower Tech is the leading manufacturer of products that effectively bridge the gap between
sustainability and energy efficiency. Tower Tech offers the highest quality products with patented
technology providing innovative solutions.

[ View Our Cooling Towers ][128]

## Industries Served

Made from the highest-quality composites, Tower Tech modular cooling towers bring their advanced
technologies to these industries:
* ### Industrial
  
  [Collapse this item] [Collapse this item]
  [manufacturing-20170607_080452]
  
  Tower Tech is the leader for modular cooling towers in industrial applications. Our towers are the
  strongest and most efficient on the market and have FM Approvals for fire, storm and seismic
  ratings. We specialize in serving:
  * Chemicals & Plastics
  * Oil & Gas
  * Manufacturing & Food
  * Automotive & EV Battery
  * Semiconductors & Data Centers
  * Sustainability & Emerging Markets
  
  
  ### HVAC
  
  [Collapse this item] [Collapse this item]
  [real-estate-r-IMG_20200611_171515324]
  
  Tower Tech is the leader for factory-built cooling towers in HVAC and Comfort Cooling
  applications. Our towers are the most efficient towers on the market and have the lowest total
  cost of ownership. We specialize in serving:
  * Healthcare
  * Education
  * Hospitality
  * Government & Military
  * Commercial Real Estate
  
  
  ### Power Plants
  
  [Collapse this item] [Collapse this item]
  [power-plant-20190515_103631]
  
  Tower Tech is the leader for applications where redundancy and energy efficiency are paramount.
  Our cooling towers can remain up-and-running even if a fan or other modular component goes down.
  When is comes to flexibility Tower Tech towers provide maximum utility to power plants and
  utilities providers.
  
  
  ### Rental Towers
  
  [Collapse this item] [Collapse this item]
  [temporary-towers]
  
  Tower Tech is the leader for applications that are seasonal or necessitate a short term cooling
  tower solution. Our cooling towers are modular and because they are factory built they can be
  easily transported and installed. Our technology can get your application or facility's cooling
  back on-line in the shortest amount of time.

Tower Tech created our BabyTech demo tower to showcase our tower's functionality as well as their
modularity. The BabyTech is a fully functioning mini-tower that is 75% smaller than our standard
4-fan tower.

About Vistech

## Industrial Cooling Systems UK

We specialise in delivering industry leading [Cooling Solutions][111] that not only improve
efficiency, but are intelligently designed to minimise waste and reduce the need for maintenance. If
you’re looking for a brand new [Cooling Tower][112] or just a [refurbishment][113] of your current
system, we’re here to help at any stage of your project.

We’ve created in-depth [articles and guides][114] supported by 50 years of experience to help you
find the right solution for your company. You can learn more about [Smart Cooling Towers][115], find
out about the benefits of [Adiabatic Cooling][116], discover how [Drift Eliminators][117] save your
resources, gain an insight into [GRP Lining][118], or learn all you could need to know about
[Cooling Tower Packing][119].

If you’d prefer a faster analysis, you can answer a few quick questions in our [Cooling Tower
Diagnostic Tool][120]. In less than two minutes we’ll analyse your requirements based on some
carefully selected criteria and suggest the most cost-effective solution.

Our experts are on call to assist you with any enquiry you might have. If you’d like to contact us
for a no obligation chat about your needs you can reach us via our live chat, [sending us an
email][121], or giving us a call. We’ll be happy to discuss the best solutions for your specific
requirements.

About Vistech

## Industrial Cooling Systems UK

We specialise in delivering industry leading [Cooling Solutions][111] that not only improve
efficiency, but are intelligently designed to minimise waste and reduce the need for maintenance. If
you’re looking for a brand new [Cooling Tower][112] or just a [refurbishment][113] of your current
system, we’re here to help at any stage of your project.

We’ve created in-depth [articles and guides][114] supported by 50 years of experience to help you
find the right solution for your company. You can learn more about [Smart Cooling Towers][115], find
out about the benefits of [Adiabatic Cooling][116], discover how [Drift Eliminators][117] save your
resources, gain an insight into [GRP Lining][118], or learn all you could need to know about
[Cooling Tower Packing][119].

If you’d prefer a faster analysis, you can answer a few quick questions in our [Cooling Tower
Diagnostic Tool][120]. In less than two minutes we’ll analyse your requirements based on some
carefully selected criteria and suggest the most cost-effective solution.

Our experts are on call to assist you with any enquiry you might have. If you’d like to contact us
for a no obligation chat about your needs you can reach us via our live chat, [sending us an
email][121], or giving us a call. We’ll be happy to discuss the best solutions for your specific
requirements.

## Welltech Cooling Systems - FAQs

#### What types of cooling towers do you offer?

We offer a range of cooling towers including open-circuit, closed-circuit, and hybrid models. Each
type is designed to meet specific cooling needs and operational requirements.

#### How do I choose the right cooling tower for my application?

Selecting the right cooling tower depends on factors such as your cooling capacity needs, budget,
energy efficiency requirements, and environmental considerations. Contact us for personalized
recommendations based on your specific needs.

#### What is the installation process for a cooling tower?

The installation process involves preparing the site, assembling the cooling tower, connecting the
piping and electrical systems, and performing a thorough test and inspection. Our team can guide you
through each step or handle the installation for you.

#### How do I maintain my cooling tower?

Regular maintenance includes checking water quality, cleaning the tower, inspecting components for
wear, and ensuring the system operates efficiently. We offer maintenance services and support to
keep your cooling tower in optimal condition.

#### Can I get a quote for a cooling tower?

Yes, you can receive a free quote by filling out our online form or calling us directly. Provide
details about your requirements, and we’ll provide pricing and information tailored to your needs.

#### What warranties do you offer on your cooling towers?

We offer warranties on our cooling towers that cover manufacturing defects and certain components.
Details of the warranty are provided with each purchase and can be reviewed with our sales team.

#### Do you provide support and service after purchase?

Yes, we offer comprehensive support and service after purchase, including installation assistance,
maintenance, and repairs. Our team is available to address any questions or issues that may arise.

#### Where are your cooling towers manufactured?

Our cooling towers are manufactured using high-quality materials and advanced technology to ensure
durability and efficiency. We source components from reputable suppliers to meet industry standards.
